applies_to: FläktGroup air handling units controlled by ISYteq 4.0, software version 1.3.0.2.
summary: ISYteq 4.0 is FläktGroup's AHU control system with BACnet IP / MS/TP (B-BC) and Modbus always included. The full BMS communication list covers unit enables and operation mode, temperature, humidity, air quality, fan, damper and heat-recovery setpoints and control values, sensors, outputs, equipment faults, collective alarms and a BMS heartbeat pair. Which objects a unit actually has depends on its configuration; FläktGroup's four example sheets (rotary, plate, ReCooler HP, rotary with active mixing) are subsets of this list.
notes: Rows that exist only on Modbus (no BACnet object) are left out.
Some BACnet objects appear on several Modbus registers (e.g. AV 133012, 233012, 2929014); each is listed once.
Instance numbers repeat across object types (e.g. BV 3939041 BMS Heartbeat Read and BO 3939041 Alarm Collected Active B); map by type and instance.
Object names are printed with a leading space in the workbook; trimmed here.
A unit-specific list can be generated from the controller: export the EDE file, then use BMSList.xls in servdoc.zip ('Create Custom BMS List').

source.title: ISYteq 4.0 BMS Communication list SW version 1.3.0.2 (Full BMS communication list)

integration.summary: Set the BACnet datalink in the HMI (log in as Admin), export the EDE file, then command the unit with MV 3939011 Unit Operation Mode and the temperature setpoint. Keep the BMS heartbeat objects toggling if the unit uses them, and read temperatures, fan status and the collective alarm outputs.

integration.enable: MV 3939011 Unit Operation Mode (R/W) selects Automatic, Room Frost Protection, Low/High Speed, Free Profile 1/2 or Night Purge. BV 3030081 Unit Enable Via Temperature Control and the humidity / air-quality equivalents can also enable the unit. The integration manual's optional High priority function (Operating data > 8.8 BMS) lets BMS values override user inputs and profiles.
integration.heartbeat: BV 3939041 BMS Heartbeat Read and BV 3939042 BMS Heartbeat Write are described only as objects to check that the BMS is alive; the list gives no timeout or fallback behaviour.
setup: Log in to the HMI as Admin (default password Admin) to change network settings.
BACnet MS/TP defaults on RS-485 interface 1: address 1, baud 19200, BC net 101, MaxMaster 127, MaxInfoFrames 10.
BACnet settings: /Configuration/Network/BACnet/General (device ID, EDE export; restart after changing the device ID). IP datalinks under /Datalinks.
Unit conversion for temperature, flow, pressure and area objects is set under /Configuration/Network/BACnet/Unit conversion.
gotchas: Writing setpoints from the BMS does not save them to a profile; the integration manual describes a Modbus 'Save Profile Selection' tag for that.
With High priority enabled, BMS values override HMI and profile settings.
